messages.author: aea7e3932bcd0b7f
messages.subject: Re: rhbase 1.1 error
parts:
Can be fixed by:
* tar -xzf rhbase_1.1.tar.gz
* cd rhbase
* dos2unix configure configure
* cd ..
* tar -czf rhbase_1.1.tar.gz rhbase

/Nicolas

messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#623] Re: rhbase 1.1 error
parts: Quick update. We tried to fix this instance and also understand why it happened and how to prevent it from happening again, we filtered out all CR/LF pairs from the code base (at least what is recognized as text files by extension and the configure script) and adopted a .gitattributes configuration to standardize on LF only line breaks. If somebody uses a hyperactive windows editor, there still is room for error if they build from the local branch, but it should become more apparent in their check ins that files are being changed in unwanted ways. The fixed code is checked in, but to change the build we need to issue a bugfix release that will take just a little longer.
